name: memory
description: Notes and memories reachable from every repository and subagent: a `mem` command that searches and reads a configured store.

runner.title: Runner
runner.description: Runner for background passes that support it (settle, integrate, corroborate): claude or codex. Empty: claude. Passes that need the shell always run on Claude (ADR 0037).

store.title: Store
store.description: Folder of notes and memories that the plugin reads and writes (the global scope). Leave empty to use the default store, created on first use.

memories.title: Global memories
memories.description: Folder for memories that do not belong to one project. Leave empty to keep them in the store.

auto_curation.title: Automatic curation
auto_curation.description: When the session ends and enough memories and notes were written since the last run, start one bounded background curation (the curator in apply mode, then syntheses for topics without one). Spends model usage; off by default.

auto_curation_budget.title: Automatic curation budget (USD)
auto_curation_budget.description: Most one automatic run may spend. Default 2.

auto_curation_threshold.title: Automatic curation threshold
auto_curation_threshold.description: New global memories plus new notes since the last run that start a run. Default 10.

auto_settle.title: Automatic settling
auto_settle.description: After a global memory is written, compare it in the background with its look-alikes (a cheap model judges, the code applies only safe changes, each one undoable with mem settle undo). Spends model usage, at most one run per interval; off by default. Not yet measured.

auto_settle_minutes.title: Automatic settling interval (minutes)
auto_settle_minutes.description: Least time between two settling runs. Default 30.

auto_capture.title: Automatic capture
auto_capture.description: When a compaction starts and when the session ends, a background run reads the new part of the session's transcript with a small model and writes lessons as unconfirmed project memories (only in a project that already has its memory folder). Sends transcript text of the session to a small model through your own claude and spends model usage; off by default. Not yet measured.

auto_reword.title: Automatic rewording
auto_reword.description: After the automatic run (needs auto_capture and loaded rules on), a small model rewrites the short form of a loaded lesson whose wording got worse and a second one checks it against the lesson, with nobody reading it first; each change is undoable. Spends model usage; off by default. Not yet measured.

loaded_rules.title: Loaded rules
loaded_rules.description: Load established lessons as short rules at session start (on by default); set it to false to load none.

rules_layout.title: Loaded rules layout
rules_layout.description: How the loaded rules are printed at session start: flat (one list, the default), grouped (the same lessons under a heading per topic) or digest (grouped, with a heading and a shorter line per lesson where the digest has a fresh one). Any other value means flat.

auto_capture_budget.title: Automatic capture budget (USD per window)
auto_capture_budget.description: Upper limit of what one capture window (one model session) may spend. Default 0.25.

offload_table.title: Offload table
offload_table.description: Loads the table that says which work to hand to subagents (about 2100 characters) at session start, after /clear and after a compaction, and skips itself when ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md already holds the table. Turn it off when the table reaches the session another way (a project CLAUDE.md, an imported file, account instructions).

research_depth.title: Research depth
research_depth.description: How far mem-research goes by default: memory (only what the memory says), contrast (also checks chosen notes and the question against up to 5 web pages, at most 0.50 USD and 5 minutes) or deep (up to 15 pages, papers asked for, at most 2 USD and 15 minutes). Default contrast. Spends model usage; not yet measured.
